description: The chart illustrates the inference time in minutes for different models, comparing their performance across various categories. The horizontal axis represents the inference time, labeled as "Inference Time (minute)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7 minutes in the right chart and 0 to 2.5 minutes in the left chart, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5 and 1, respectively. The vertical axis is not explicitly labeled but contains categories represented by different colored bars. The bars are grouped into five categories: Baseline (green), Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow), SFT (gray), DPO (orange), and O1-Pruner (blue). In both charts, the bars are arranged in the same order, with O1-Pruner having the shortest length, approximately 1.1 and 4 minutes, and Baseline having the longest length, approximately 2.1 and 6 minutes. The bars are not sorted in a specific order other than being grouped by category, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart is presented in two versions, with the left chart showing a zoomed-in view of the inference times, focusing on the range up to 2.5 minutes, while the right chart displays the full range up to 7 minutes.
